Third-party code, do not edit. math-verify and its LaTeX parser (tok_exam/grader.py); matplotlib 3.9.2 and its pure deps (tok_exam/plots.py, installed with --no-deps).
Installed with: pip install --target vendor math-verify==0.8.0 (sympy/mpmath copies removed so baseenv's sympy 1.13.1, which torch needs, is used).
